claims: Wake Forest University is a private liberal arts university in Winston-Salem, North Carolina.
Wake Forest University has a 11:1 student-faculty ratio.
Wake Forest University has a 21.67% acceptance rate (2024).
Wake Forest University's admitted students have ACT scores ranging from 32-34.
U.S. News & World Report ranked Wake Forest University #51 in National Universities.
U.S. News & World Report ranked Wake Forest University #12 in Best Undergraduate Teaching.
Wake Forest University has ~5,400–5,500 undergraduate students.
Wake Forest University's athletic teams are the Demon Deacons.
Wake Forest University competes in the Atlantic Coast Conference (ACC).
Wake Forest University has a 340-acre campus.
Wake Forest University has additional facilities at Wake Downtown in the Innovation Quarter.
Over 72% of Wake Forest University's undergraduates participate in study abroad programs.
NBA player Chris Paul is an alumnus of Wake Forest University.
NBA player Tim Duncan is an alumnus of Wake Forest University.
Actor/comedian David Alan Grier is an alumnus of Wake Forest University.
The "Pit" is the main dining hall at Wake Forest University.
The town of Wake Forest, NC, is a separate entity located near Raleigh.
